title: Agent Notifications custom webhook payload
description: JSON payload sent to custom webhook endpoints (notifications.webhook.preset = "", format = "json"). Slack/Discord/Telegram/Lark presets use platform-native shapes instead and are not covered by this schema. schema_version follows semantic-ish rules: a breaking change (field removed, renamed, or retyped) bumps the major-equivalent value; new optional fields do not.

status.description: Notification status/type. Kept for backward compatibility; identical value to notification_type.

notification_type.description: Explicit alias for status, meant as the stable field to key off of for notification identity.

agent_source.description: Which coding agent produced the event. New agents may add new values over time; unrecognized values should be treated as forward-compatible, not an error.

message.description: Human-readable notification message, including the session name prefix.

timestamp.description: RFC3339 timestamp of when the webhook was sent.

source.description: Identifies the plugin that sent the webhook (not the agent that triggered it).
